question: Listá los fármacos con target PDCD1 o CD274 (anti-PD-1 o anti-PD-L1) que tienen ensayos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) en cáncer de pulmón.

attempts.query:
WITH drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.parent_chembl_id, p.pref_name
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = md.parent_chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol IN ('PDCD1','CD274')
),
names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pref_name, n FROM (
    SELECT d.pref_name, lower(d.pref_name) AS n FROM drugs d
    UNION
    SELECT d.pref_name, lower(s.synonyms) FROM drugs d
    JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.parent_chembl_id = d.parent_chembl_id
    JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id
  ) x WHERE length(n) >= 5
),
trials AS (
  SELECT s.nct_id FROM aact.studies s
  WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms')
),
tnames AS (
  SELECT lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT nm.pref_name
FROM tnames tn JOIN names nm ON position(nm.n IN tn.n) > 0
ORDER BY 1
